# PATCH /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}

Edit a repository's properties. Only fields that are set will be changed.

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-369`

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Cannot change private repo to public when ForcePrivate is enabled (non-admin) | validation | visibilityChanged && setting.Repository.ForcePrivate && !*opts.Private && !ctx.Doer.IsAdmin |
| Fork visibility is forced to match base repository | validation | repo.IsFork && opts.Private != nil |
| Mirror interval must be >= setting.Mirror.MinInterval | validation | interval != 0 && interval < setting.Mirror.MinInterval |
| Cannot archive/unarchive a mirror repository | validation | repo.IsMirror && opts.Archived != nil |
| Default branch change only applied if branch exists or repo is empty | business_logic | opts.DefaultBranch != nil && repo.DefaultBranch != *opts.DefaultBranch && (repo.IsEmpty || gitrepo.IsBranchExist(...)) |
| Archiving a repo cleans scheduled action tasks | business_logic | *opts.Archived == true |
| Unarchiving a repo re-detects action schedules | business_logic | *opts.Archived == false && repo has Actions unit enabled |

### Error Paths

- **Name already exists** → ctx.APIError → 422
- **Cannot change private to public (ForcePrivate)** → ctx.APIError → 422
- **Mirror interval too short** → ctx.APIError → 422
- **Cannot archive mirror** → ctx.APIError → 422

## 🛡️ Resiliency

**Risk Level:** medium

| Pattern | Status | Severity | Detail |
|---------|--------|----------|--------|
| non_atomic | ✅ configured | medium | Edit performs multiple sequential updates (basic props, units, archive, mirror) - partial failure leaves repo in inconsistent state |

**Non-atomic operations:**
- ⚠️ updateBasicProperties + updateRepoUnits + updateRepoArchivedState + updateMirror are separate operations

**Cascading failure risk:** Partial update could leave repo with inconsistent unit configuration

**Graceful degradation:** Each sub-function returns error immediately, stopping further updates
